Subject: Re: Mutual action plan: target go-live week? — Final checkpoint notes

Thanks everyone for the calls and updates this week — summary and decisions below (final checkpoint before acceptance gate on Aug 25).

Final decisions:
- Launch date: Aug 28, 2026 (cutover window: 02:00–05:00 UTC).
- Acceptance gate: Aug 25 EOD — HealthNet Product Owner will confirm smoke test pass and sign contract exhibit.
- Rollback plan: Immediate rollback to previous model routing (fallback to hosted v2) if any critical errors in first 30 minutes post-cutover; extended rollback within 4 hours if persistent errors.
- Contingency: If capacity/latency exceeds SLA during cutover, failover to Redwood Dedicated burst pool in us-west-2 for up to 6 hours.

Action items (owners & status):
- Ben Carter — SOC2 artifacts uploaded; follow up with engineering on retention window ticket by Aug 16. (Status: In progress)
- Soojin Lee — Cutover runbook v2 uploaded (cutover_runbook_v2.md); assigned runbook reviewer: Karthik. Review complete by Aug 20. (Status: Draft uploaded)
- Karthik Iyer — Schedule preflight test on Aug 24; provide latency/throughput summary and KV cache warm-up script. (Status: Scheduled)
- Laura Bennett — Finalize PO and confirm SLA clause around rollback/uptime; send executed order by Aug 21. (Status: In progress)
- Mina Haddad — Coordinate acceptance gate and facilitate Aug 25 sign-off meeting. (Status: Planned)

Meeting cadence: Weekly MAP checkpoint remains Tuesdays 11:00 PT until go-live; ad-hoc triage call scheduled for Aug 27 if any late blockers appear.

Links & references:
- MAP tracker: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcD-MAP-HealthNet

- DocuSign pre-sign: https://www.docusign.com/Envelope/12345-HealthNet-MAP
